Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.label: H-47
Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.description:
A rotary wing airlifter, the H-47 can carry lots of cargo to where aeroplanes can't land. It is fast and has a large cargo capacity, but is still slower than large aeroplanes.

Not perticularly fuel efficient, however the ability to fly over terrain means it sometimes is more effient than land vehicles.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x1, Passenger x40
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
